programs.desc: The Lightning face the Canadiens in Game 3 at Bell Centre. After Josh Anderson gave Montreal a 2-1 lead, Nikita Kucherov tied it at 12:33 of the third to force OT. J.J. Moser scored at 12:48 into OT to seal the Lightning's win in Game 2.

programs.desc: Pittsburgh plays Philadelphia in Game 6 of the East first round at Xfinity Mobile Arena. Philadelphia currently leads the series 3-2. Sidney Crosby had two assists despite a brief injury. Kris Letang scored the winner in the second period.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Avalanche host the Wild at Ball Arena for a pivotal Game 5 matchup. Following a recent 5-2 victory, Colorado leads this series 3-1. Minnesota looks to Kirill Kaprizov to avoid elimination and counter a Colorado offense led by Nathan MacKinnon.
